PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),
    "L_in":    (0.18, 0.15, 0.4),
    "gmid_ld": (8.0, 5.0, 12.0),
    "L_ld":    (0.25, 0.15, 0.6),
    "gmid_t":  (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),
    "L_t":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "Itail":   (64e-6, 30e-6, 72e-6),
    "R1":      (60e3, 20e3, 200e3),
    "ratio":   (0.122, 0.105, 0.135),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 0.3e-12)
    vdd = 1.8
    It = p["Itail"]; Ih = It / 2.0

    # devices
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Ih, vds=0.45, vsb=0.18)    # input pair
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], Ih, vds=0.9)               # PMOS mirror load
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], It, vds=0.2)                 # tail
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], iref, vds=mt.vgs)            # bias diode (same L, gm/Id)

    R1 = p["R1"]; Rf = p["ratio"] * R1

    n = Netlist("vin1 vin2 vout vcm vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # diff pair: M1 gate = inverting input (node vn), M2 gate = vcm (non-inverting)
    n.dev("M1", "vout", "vn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "xd", "vcm", "tail", "vss", m1)
    # mirror load: diode on M2 side, output on M1 side -> vn is inverting input
    n.dev("M3", "xd", "xd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "xd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # feedback network
    n.R("R1", "vin1", "vn", R1)
    n.R("RF", "vn", "vout", Rf)
    # unused input: benign termination
    n.R("R2", "vin2", "vcm", 1e6)

    # predictions
    beta = R1 / (R1 + Rf)
    gout = m1.gds + m3.gds + 1.0 / (R1 + Rf)
    A = m1.gm / gout
    T = A * beta
    a1 = -(Rf / R1) * T / (1.0 + T)
    cout = cl + m1.cdd + m3.cdd + 0.3 * m1.cgg * beta
    bw = (gout * (1.0 + T)) / (2 * PI * cout)
    # node-pole sanity: (R1||Rf)*cgg
    fnode = 1.0 / (2 * PI * (R1 * Rf / (R1 + Rf)) * (m1.cgg + 5e-15))
    bw = 1.0 / (1.0 / bw + 0.5 / fnode)
    vnat = vdd - m3.vgs
    offset = (vnat - 0.9) / (1.0 + T)
    power = 1.98 * (It + iref)
    return n, {"a1": a1, "bw": bw, "vout_offset": offset, "power": power}
